missed_functions.function: External shunt sense input: the low-capacitance TVS (transient-voltage-suppression) diode behind the two 1 kOhm series resistors (IOBoard.md:464, owner 2026-09-30)
missed_functions.why: P2 returned only the INA228 for 'External shunt sense input' and left the 85 V withstand to 'the stage-2 TVS'. The R8 row names 'the IO board's input for its sense leads'. Research.md Rules of stage 1 sends only the protection on the signal, sensor, balance-lead, link and heartbeat connectors to stage 2, and names the shunts, USB protection, power input protection and ESC pack path protection as stage 1; the external shunt's sense leads are none of the listed connectors, and IOBoard.md:464 says only 'round 2'. The TVS therefore has no entry in P2's return and no stage assigned on the page. Its clamp voltage and placement are not stated (IOBoard.md:464). The 1 kOhm resistors are resistors, left to stage 2.
